nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Escape hatch for the LINE MCP tools whose JSON schema Gemini cannot parse and that no dedicated tool covers: create_rich_menu and the two broadcast tools.

nodes.name: Validate Call
nodes.notes: Allowlists the tool, gates broadcasting behind a workflow switch, and parses the model's argument JSON.

nodes.name: Call LINE MCP
nodes.notes: tool.value is an expression: the MCP Client node reads it per item, so one node can dispatch to any tool name.

nodes.name: Tool Result
nodes.notes: Last node of the sub-workflow: this is what the agent receives as the tool result.
